dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: If only I could open up another uncut rock! The next one will surely be the real deal. I can feel it!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for Xi, right now, I'd be...

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: Huh, are you also interested in betting on rocks? Then you've come to the right man. Let me tell you how it's done!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: You cannot judge the value of these stones based on their outward face. A real expert also knows how to use their nose!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: This is deep water indeed. I would say that even with my prodigious talents, it took me at least eight years of practice to really grasp the technique.

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for Xi's constant nagging that my father was coming to catch me, which affected my judgment... I would definitely have figured it out!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: See, I would have chosen that yellow one! And if I had, would I still be in this state now?

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: Don't bring her into this. I may have lost my bet at The Jade Mystery over a hundred times, but this is what they call gaining experience... was there ever a venture that was all gain and no loss, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: But my stubborn old man wouldn't listen. He booted me out in a fit of pique!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: At least Mother understood me, and sent Xi after me with some traveling expenses.

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: ...But she only ever gives me a little every day. I have to save for half a month before I can open one stone!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, no matter. Soon, I will be back in the saddle... no, I shall be on the rise!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: Thank you! Once my luck turns, watch me buy over the entire Wangshu Inn!

dialogues.speaker: Master Hui
dialogues.text: ...Then I'll make Xi clean every single plate in the inn. That'll show her.
